faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Vadodara Assistant Professor Grade - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Professor Grade - II positions at IIIT Vadodara is 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor Grade - II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor Grade - II position at Indian Institute of Information Technology Vadodara.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is a Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree, along with at least two research papers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor Grade - II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 70,900 to Rs. 98,200 per month, corresponding to Level - 10.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Nil for General and OBC categories. For SC/ST and Women candidates, the application fee is Rs. 1180.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIIT Vadodara Assistant Professor Grade - II positions?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIIT Vadodara or via the direct application link provided in the important links section.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of application forms, followed by a written test, presentation, and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Assistant Professor Grade - II posts?
faq.answer: Specific age limits are not detailed here. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related criteria and relaxations.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains comprehensive details about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of IIIT Vadodara?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Information Technology Vadodara is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 382028.
